1_lifestyle_usecase.purpose: Show the product in a real-world setting to build desire.
1_lifestyle_usecase.prompt: Photorealistic lifestyle shot of a stylish young woman wearing a minimalist white smartwatch on her wrist while holding a coffee cup in a bright, modern cafe. Natural sunlight, soft bokeh background, 1:1 aspect ratio, high resolution.

2_before_after.prompt: Split screen comparison. Left side: A plain, boring wrist with an old bulky black watch. Right side: The same wrist looking elegant and modern wearing the minimalist white smartwatch. High-end fashion photography style, 1:1 aspect ratio.

3_how_to_use.prompt: Close-up shot of hands adjusting the white silicone strap of the smartwatch. Focus on the buckle mechanism and the texture of the silicone. Clean, studio lighting, white background, 1:1 aspect ratio.

4_enhanced_hero.prompt: Premium studio product photography of the white smartwatch floating slightly above a clean white marble surface. Soft dramatic shadows, cinematic lighting, highlighting the circular black glass display, 1:1 aspect ratio, 8k resolution.
